content.title: "20/20: The Neighbor From Hell" Coming Soon To ABC, Hulu & Disney+ - What's On Disney Plus
content.text: Disney has announced details on an upcoming episode of its award-winning documentary series, “20/20”, which is called “The Neighbor From Hell” and will be coming to Disney+, Hulu and ABC later this week. In Ocala, Florida, a longstanding rift between neighbours ended with a single gunshot fired through a locked front door when, on the night of June 2, 2023, 58-year-old Susan Lorincz shot and killed her neighbour, 35-year-old Ajike Owens — a mother of four — while her sons were nearby. Now, Owens’ mother, Pamela Dias, and 12-year-old son Izzy, speak exclusively with Deborah Roberts, opening up about Ajike’s life, the tragic event, and how they are dealing with the loss. Owens and Lorincz had been feuding for more than a year, and Lorincz had repeatedly complained to police about Owens’ children and other neighbourhood kids playing loudly near her apartment. On the night of the shooting, Owens’ son said Lorincz swung an umbrella and threw a roller skate at him, which she has denied. Owens went to Lorincz’s apartment to confront her and began pounding on the door. Lorincz fired her pistol, fatally shooting Owens. The case has garnered national attention, and for the first time, law enforcement speaks out on the investigation, including their numerous interactions with Lorincz, which were often captured on officer body cameras. Lorincz had told investigators she believed Owens was attempting to break through the locked metal door. The shooting sparked community outrage, and Lorincz ultimately was arrested. Following a jury trial in August 2024, Lorincz was found guilty of manslaughter with a firearm and was sentenced to 25 years in prison. ABC News’ “20/20” is the No. 1 award-winning primetime program anchored by David Muir and Deborah Roberts. A proven leader as a long-form newsmagazine for over 45 years, “20/20” features unforgettable, character-driven true-crime mysteries, exclusive newsmaker interviews, hard-hitting investigative reports, and in-depth coverage of high-profile stories. Janice Johnston is the executive producer. “20/20” co-anchor Deborah Roberts hosts this documentary, and it will air on Friday, 3rd April 2026 at 9 pm on ABC, and it will stream the next day on Disney+ and Hulu in the United States. Recent episodes of “20/20” are also available to stream on Disney+ and Hulu. Are you going to be checking out this new episode of “20/20”? Let me know on social media!
